title: Binary subtraction of encoded inputs
statement: For a Boolean list $z$, define its difference to be the binary expansion of the truncated natural-number subtraction of the value represented by the second decoded component of $z$ from the value represented by the first decoded component.
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definitions specifying how the list is split or how each component is decoded.
